name.text: [PSY-GAD-001] GAD Diagnostic Duration and Autonomic Symptoms

questiontext.text:
According to DSM-5-TR and WHO ICD-11 diagnostic criteria, what is the minimum duration of excessive, uncontrollable worry required to establish a diagnosis of Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)?

Source: PsychStats Knowledge Base

generalfeedback.text: Diagnostic validity for GAD requires excessive anxiety occurring more days than not for at least 6 months about multiple life domains (Source: PsychStats Wiki / DSM-5-TR).

answer.text: At least 6 months, occurring more days than not

feedback.text: Correct. DSM-5-TR and ICD-11 mandate persistent worry for at least 6 months accompanied by minimum 3 autonomic/motor symptoms.

answer.text: At least 2 weeks, accompanied by depressed mood

feedback.text: Incorrect. A 2-week threshold characterizes a Major Depressive Episode, not GAD.

answer.text: At least 1 month following an identifiable acute stressor

feedback.text: Incorrect. This timeline describes Acute Stress Disorder or Adjustment Disorder.

answer.text: At least 12 months with intermittent panic attacks

feedback.text: Incorrect. 12 months is not required for primary GAD diagnostic threshold.

name.text: [PSY-CBT-002] CBT Graded Exposure Mechanism in Panic Disorder

questiontext.text:
In first-line Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) protocols for panic disorder, what is the primary neurobehavioral mechanism underlying interoceptive exposure?

Source: PsychStats Knowledge Base

generalfeedback.text: Interoceptive exposure targets conditioned fear of somatic sensations, facilitating cognitive restructuring across 12-16 weekly clinical sessions (Source: PsychStats Wiki).

answer.text: Extinction of catastrophic misinterpretations via systematic habituation to somatic sensations

feedback.text: Correct. Interoceptive exposure induces benign somatic sensations (hyperventilation, tachycardia) to facilitate inhibitory learning and cognitive re-appraisal.

answer.text: Immediate suppression of autonomic arousal through deep diaphragmatic avoidance

feedback.text: Incorrect. Somatic suppression acts as a safety behavior that maintains panic vulnerability.
Incorrect. This reflects psychoanalytic models, not empirical CBT learning theory.
Incorrect. Pharmacodynamics relates to SSRI pharmacotherapy, not behavioral exposure.

questiontext.text:
A patient completes a standardized Depression Scale where the normative mean is 50 with a standard deviation of 10. The patient obtains a raw score of 72. What is their standardized Z-score, and how is it interpreted clinically?

Source: PsychStats Knowledge Base

generalfeedback.text: Standard score transformation Z = (X - μ) / σ maps patient metrics onto the standard Gaussian curve for clinical normative benchmarking (Source: PsychStats Wiki / Layer 3 Normalization).

answer.text: Z = +2.20; indicates severe symptomatology exceeding 98% of the normative population

feedback.text: Correct. Z = (72 - 50) / 10 = 2.20. In standard Gaussian distributions, Z >= 2.0 indicates clinical elevation exceeding the 97.7th percentile.

answer.text: Z = +1.20; indicates mild distress within the average range

feedback.text: Incorrect. Sign error; a raw score of 72 is above the mean, yielding a positive Z-score.

answer.text: Z = +22.0; indicates statistical invalidity of the assessment instrument

feedback.text: Incorrect. Division by standard deviation was omitted in this calculation.

name.text: [CLIN-ETHICS-004] Clinical AI SaMD Liability & Legal Oversight

questiontext.text:
Under Indonesian Health Law (UU RI No. 17 Tahun 2023) and the JPAIS-MED-REF Clinical Oversight Standards, who holds legal diagnostic responsibility when a clinician uses an AI Clinical Decision Support (CDS) recommendation?

Source: PsychStats Knowledge Base

generalfeedback.text: The Physician-in-the-Loop (PITL) mandate enforces that AI CDS operates strictly as an advisory instrument, preserving human clinician accountability (Source: JPAIS-MED-REF / UU No. 17/2023).

answer.text: The licensed human clinician (DPJP / Psikolog Klinis) retains sole medical responsibility

feedback.text: Correct. Under UU No. 17/2023 and JPAIS-MED-REF, AI CDS tools are advisory instruments; legal diagnostic responsibility cannot be transferred to algorithms.

answer.text: The cloud software vendor hosting the LLM API endpoint

feedback.text: Incorrect. Cloud software vendors provide technical infrastructure, not licensed medical diagnosis.

answer.text: Joint statutory liability shared equally between the AI model and the hospital IT department

feedback.text: Incorrect. Clinical liability under Indonesian law rests strictly with licensed professionals.

answer.text: The Ministry of Health (Kemenkes RI) through automatic state indemnity

feedback.text: Incorrect. Kemenkes regulates clinical practice guidelines but does not assume individual practitioner liability.
